title: Riftbound Regional Qualifier Utrecht - Day 1 (Top 8 Playoffs)
source: local VOD (E:/ [6-14-26] Riftbound - Riftbound Regional Qualifier Utrecht - Day 1.mp4)
format: 13 rounds Swiss -> Top 8 BO3 single elimination

champion.note: Defending European RQ champion (RQ Lille); 2nd-ever two-time RQ champion after AlanZQ; longest competitive win streak in Riftbound (casters cited ~28 series undefeated, 38-2-4 game record across 3 RQs)

runnerUp.note: First RQ ever, solo from Athens/Greece, playing Viktor since Origins; underdog vs team captain Squirtle

top8Swiss.note: RQ Houston winner; also Top 4 at RQ Vancouver
Snuck into top 8 on tiebreakers (10-2 swing)

keyInsights: Most diverse Top 8 to date: 8 different legends across 8 players (Azir, Viktor, Sett, Diana, Rek'Sai, Darius, Master Yi, Annie) - even more open than Vancouver (6/8).
The final was a token mirror: Azir Sand Soldiers (equipment cascade + legend ability) vs Viktor Recruits (Victor Leader death-readies, Sprite Fountain swarm).
Pickpocket out of Rednaxell's sideboard was the key tech vs Azir, stripping the 1-cost gears (BF Sword, Soul Sword, Doran's Shield, Eye of the Herald) that fuel Azir's engine.
Squirtle wins back-to-back European RQs (Lille -> Utrecht), becomes the 2nd two-time RQ champion right after AlanZQ at Vancouver, extending the longest series win streak in the game.

Underdog run: Rednaxell, first RQ, solo from Greece on a Viktor he's played since Origins, beat Rek'Sai then a near-perfect defensive Diana from Dwali (lost to a Sprite Fountain topdeck on the conquer-draw) to reach the final.
Team Mycelium (MICE) put 3 players in the Top 8 (Squirtle, Ramekiano, DiamondHat).
Casters' meta read: 'Order is the new Chaos' - Order legends (Azir, Sett) were strong; token strategies dominated the late bracket.
